body:
- Added VoiceOver accessibility (#1448).
- Added drag and drop reordering of pinned items.
- Added editing of pinned items inside the preview. The Pins settings pane is removed.
- Added support for special symbols as pin keys (`[];'./-=\`).
- Added image size to the image preview (#1589).
- Added support for ignoring apps outside /Applications (#1540).
- Improved OCR accuracy with automatic language detection (#1586).
- Removed Safari WebArchives and other unselected pasteboard types storage (#1543).
- Fixed memory leak of every history item (#1552).
- Fixed slow menu bar title rendering with large history (#1551).
- Fixed orphaned history item content not being cleaned up (#1509).
- Fixed hang on macOS 26 caused by U+FFFC in titles (#1524).
- Fixed hidden footer warning not wrapping in long translations (#1592).
- Fixed settings window being too narrow (#1505).
- Migrated to Swift 6 (#1532).

- Updated app icon for Liquid Glass (#1474) (credits to @genucoder).
- Increased the minimum popup height to 3 history items.
- Added Portuguese translation.
- Added Khmer translation.
- Fixed paste without formatting not pasting (#1473).
- Fixed bug freeze due to a closed preview still receiving mouse events (#1484).
- Fixed selection jump to the previous item when deleting the first unpinned item (#1485).
- Fixed crash when copying the bottom-most pinned item at full capacity (#1466).
- Fixed preview shortcut registering as a global hotkey (#1482).
- Fixed height increasing upon preview open, even though it's sufficient.
- Fixed a double separator when history has no non-pinned items.
- Fixed preview text not taking up the width.

- Redesigned image/text preview as a slideout panel with a toolbar, openable via `⌃Space`.
- Added a button to copy OCR text from an image.
- Added a setting to toggle auto-open preview (#1440).
- Added a setting to toggle a HEX color swatch (#1338).
- Show image dimensions in the preview (#1357).
- Improved memory usage and performance (cache decoded images, skip history fetch when checking for similar items, render long text with `NSTextView`, using asynchronous views).
- Fixed `⌃K` (kill-to-end) when already on the first item (#1460).
- Raised the pop-up above Chrome autofill (#1403).
- Keep the pop-up constrained to the active screen (#1421, #1452).
- Refresh the app icon after the source app is updated (#1461).
- Fixed open preferences warning text overflow on long localizations (#1329).
- Fixed an issue when transient pasteboard types from VS Code and Notes would create duplicate items.
- Improved Persian/Croatian/Uzbek/Spanish translations (#1282, #1290).

* Fixed a crash when copying on macOS 14 (#1264).
* Fixed a text beam cursor when hovering a header with a hidden search field.

* Improved UI for macOS 26 Tahoe.
* Improved memory management.
* Fixed a crash when deleting multiple items in a row.
* Fixed a bug when the pop-up would not grow automatically after being moved.
* Fixed IME conversion confirmation on Japanese input (#1222).
